facts.fact: BusinessDay states ngCERT, the Nigeria Computer Emergency Response Team, operates as the country's internet police unit under the Office of the National Security Adviser.
BusinessDay states ngCERT issued at least 33 cyberattack advisories since July 2023, including a July 8 2024 advisory on ransomware and a May 27 2024 advisory on the Grandoreiro banking trojan.
BusinessDay reports ngCERT advisories totalled 33 since July 2023, of which 22 were in 2024 up to July 12, by month from three in January to four in July.

systems.owner: Office of the National Security Adviser
